text: Welcome to your consultation. I see you are experiencing generalized fatigue, severe itching, and abnormal liver function tests; to determine the underlying cause, please tell me your age and if you have a history of liver disease or alcohol consumption.

speaker: Patient
text: 32-year-old male. The patient reports a 2-month history of increasing generalized fatigue and severe pruritus. He has known hypertension and was diagnosed with ulcerative colitis 5 years ago. He mentions being sexually active with 2 female partners and inconsistent condom use.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for the details. Have you noticed any jaundice, dark urine, or pale stools recently?

speaker: Patient

speaker: Doctor
